baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose clause لِّيَعْلَمَ and the sequence أَبْلَغُوا رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge is tied to a causative delivery action: the messages are made to reach their endpoint as communications issued under lordship. Completion, rather than merely beginning to speak, is the event made knowable.

activation_trace.role: A thing becoming clear to a knower supplies the purpose or result toward which completed delivery points.
Reaching a limit makes delivery an endpoint event rather than an unmeasured attempt.
Making a message reach its destination identifies the action being brought to completion.
Messenger and message supply the transmitted object and delegated communicative relation.
Lordship, ownership, and authority locate the messages within a governing source rather than the messengers' own possession.

changed_reading.before: The verse says that messengers transmitted messages and that all is known.
changed_reading.after: The verse first marks a delegated communication as successfully brought to its endpoint, making completion itself the knowable event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated clauses وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ and وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The second half moves in two scales: complete grasp of what is with the messengers, then itemized enumeration of every knowable thing. Enclosure supplies total scope while counting preserves distinctions inside that scope.

activation_trace.role: Complete grasp in knowledge or possession supplies the comprehensive outer scope.
Counting through exhaustive investigation turns comprehensive scope into an inspectable inventory.
Totality and completeness prevent anything from falling outside the inventory.
The knowable, reportable thing supplies the individual unit to which enumeration can attach.
Enumerating what is counted preserves discrete identity within the all-enclosing total.

changed_reading.before: The ending is a general assertion of exhaustive knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The ending distinguishes comprehensive enclosure from granular accounting: nothing lies outside, yet nothing disappears into an undifferentiated whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening and middle of the surah form a receiver-side chain: concealed imparting is listened to, understood, and answered by settled belief. That chain revises أَبْلَغُوا from sender-side utterance alone into delivery whose endpoint is visible in uptake.

activation_trace.role: Conveying a message anchors the changed reading in the focus verb of making communication reach.
Messenger and message identify the communication whose arrival is being tested.
Knowledge imparted in concealment supplies the initial transmission that later becomes audible and reportable.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception more than acoustic contact and supplies evidence of arrival.
Heart-settling assent supplies the downstream response by which effective reception becomes visible.

structural_cues: 72:1 sequences revelation, listening, reported hearing, and speech about what was heard.
72:13 explicitly sequences hearing the guidance and believing in it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden imparting, understanding-hearing, and assent; I infer that uptake can evidence the endpoint of delivery. A live alternative is that discharge is complete once the messenger conveys, regardless of recipient response.

changed_reading.before: Delivery is measured only from the messengers' act of speaking.
changed_reading.after: Delivery can also be read from the receiving end: the communication has arrived when it becomes heard, understood, and answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker denies owning either harm or right direction, then names conveyance and messages as the exception-like task immediately available to him. The focus therefore measures successful performance of a bounded commission, not autonomous control of outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Making the message reach anchors the limited task whose completion is affirmed.
Lordship and ownership retain governing authority at the source of the commission.
Soundly reaching the right course names an outcome the speaker says he does not control for others.
Ownership and discretionary power supply the explicitly denied capacity against which delegated delivery is bounded.
Harm or diminution supplies the second outcome denied to the messenger's independent disposal.
Conveyance names the positive commission left after the denial of outcome-control.
Messenger and messages connect that bounded commission directly to the focus wording.

structural_cues: 72:21 denies messenger ownership of harm and right direction; 72:23 names conveyance and messages; 72:28 reports that messages were delivered.
The possessive relation in رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ assigns source-authority to the Lord rather than the messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a denial of ownership followed by repeated conveyance vocabulary; I infer that the juxtaposition defines a bounded mandate. A live alternative is that the denial and the conveyance clause address distinct questions without formally delimiting an office.

changed_reading.before: The messengers' delivery sounds like an autonomous accomplishment.
changed_reading.after: Their accomplishment is exact but bounded: they complete the entrusted conveyance while guidance, harm, and sovereign outcome remain outside their ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated denials of eluding, fleeing, receiving protective asylum, or finding a side-refuge turn the focus enclosure into jurisdictional scope. Exhaustive count then means there is neither an outside from which to escape nor an unregistered item within.

activation_trace.role: Overwhelming encirclement supplies the focus-side image of a scope that cannot be exited.
Totality removes any residual class of things that might remain outside the accounting.
Outstripping pursuit and slipping away supply the explicitly negated possibility of defeating the scope.
Frightened flight supplies the second explicitly negated exit strategy.
Protective asylum in another's custody supplies the unavailable external shield.
Turning aside into a refuge supplies the unavailable lateral escape from the enclosing domain.

structural_cues: 72:12 negates escape both on earth and by flight; 72:22 negates protector and refuge.
The focus pairs enclosure with total enumeration rather than leaving either image alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four negated escape or shelter mechanisms and a focus enclosure; I infer a jurisdictional arrow from no-exit to exhaustive accountability. A live alternative is that the focus remains purely epistemic while the no-refuge passages make a separate claim about power.

changed_reading.before: Encompassing and counting describe the breadth of awareness.
changed_reading.after: They also describe inescapable accountability: no subject can leave the domain and no act can remain unregistered inside it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The selected messenger is routed through a watched corridor with surveillance before and behind. In that setting, the focus purpose clause and delivery verb read like a chain-of-custody test: the communication reaches its endpoint through a protected, observable route.

activation_trace.role: Message conveyance supplies the tracked transfer whose successful completion is at issue.
Guarding and protective care let the focus enclosure answer the context's surveillance imagery.
Watchful guarding supplies active observation of the transmission route.
Inserting one thing into another supplies deliberate routing rather than an unbounded release.
The messenger-message relation identifies the entrusted carrier inside the guarded route.
The fixed frontward relation supplies one boundary of the messenger's monitored corridor.
What lies behind, opposed to what is in front, closes the corridor's other boundary.

structural_cues: The surveillance root recurs at the blocked listening station in 72:9 and around the selected messenger in 72:27.
72:27 places guarding before and behind immediately before 72:28 states the purpose and completed delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guarded listening posts, deliberate routing, and surveillance around the messenger; I infer that these make delivery auditable as a custody chain. A live alternative is that the guards protect revelation without functioning as evidence of messenger performance.

changed_reading.before: The final knowledge statement follows delivery as a broad theological conclusion.
changed_reading.after: The final statement can function as the closure of a monitored transmission: route, carrier, payload, and arrival are all within guarded knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised event first exposes who has weaker support and fewer numbers, then raises uncertainty over nearness versus an assigned endpoint. The focus repetition of knowing and counting can therefore close both ledgers: comparative force and temporal extent.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower links the focus purpose to the preceding future unveiling.
Counted time and recurrence allow final enumeration to carry a temporal register as well as a numerical one.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the future event whose schedule is questioned.
The event making relative weakness clear anticipates the focus's second knowledge clause.
Fewness supplies the comparative manpower quantity that the focus's exhaustive count can subsume.
Explicit enumeration supplies the immediate numerical register repeated at the focus ending.
Temporal nearness and approaching completion supply one side of the timing uncertainty.
A thing's terminal extent supplies the alternative of a fixed but undisclosed horizon.

structural_cues: 72:24 joins seeing the promised event to learning who is weaker in support and fewer in number.
72:25 moves from numerical comparison to uncertainty about nearness or an appointed extent; 72:28 repeats knowing and number.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a promise, comparative number, timing uncertainty, and repeated علم/عدد; I infer that the final count closes both a force ledger and a schedule ledger. A live alternative is that عَدَدًا remains exhaustive manner alone and does not answer the timing question specifically.

changed_reading.before: Every thing is counted in a timeless, generic sense.
changed_reading.after: The final count can include both how many stand in each alignment and how far the promised term extends, answering human uncertainty with a complete force-and-time ledger.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unseen is normally concealed, then selectively exposed to an accepted messenger. Against that access rule, بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ can denote an entrusted informational holding: disclosure grants a bounded payload, while enclosure and count keep the grant fully tracked.

activation_trace.role: Complete grasp in knowledge or possession anchors full control of what remains with the messengers.
Messenger and message anchor the proposed payload in the focus's explicit communication.
Concealment from sight supplies the default access boundary around the information.
Bringing into disclosure supplies the controlled crossing of that boundary.
Acceptance rather than displeasure supplies the selection condition for access.
The selected messenger-message relation identifies the authorized bearer of disclosed material.

structural_cues: 72:26 states a concealment rule, 72:27 states a selected-messenger exception, and 72:28 speaks of what is with them.
The movement is concealment, bounded disclosure, guarded carriage, completed delivery, then exhaustive accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, selective disclosure, messenger selection, and the focus construction 'what is with them'; I infer an entrusted payload held under access control. A live alternative is that ما لديهم covers the messengers' whole circumstances rather than information specifically.

changed_reading.before: What is with the messengers is an unspecified object of comprehensive knowledge.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as selectively disclosed material held in trust: access is granted, carriage is bounded, and the payload never leaves comprehensive control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ر ب ب to ر ب و mapping and reads lordship through nurture and growth. It remains anchored in رَبِّهِمْ and is reinforced by guidance and assay branches in the context. Downstream prose should label it a split-root lexical activation, not the primary morphology of the focus form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَبِّهِمْ as a packet-authorized split root beside the delivery and knowledge clauses.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and growing up recast the Lord's messages as growth-forming communications.
Something becoming clear supplies the observable maturation outcome of the exploratory model.
Gentle direction toward the right path supplies the formative process carried by the message.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the testing process by which formation becomes disclosed.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's messages are sovereign communications whose delivery is checked.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are also nurture-bearing communications whose delivery initiates growth and assay, so knowledge registers a formed response rather than transmission alone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a material image of layers and piles into the social crowd around the worshipper, then lets final enumeration undo the crowd's visual mass. It remains anchored in كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًا and the explicit piled-crowd cue. Downstream prose should present it as a spatial-social image, not a claim that the final clause grammatically refers only to that crowd.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًا as individual enumeration within totality.

activation_trace.role: Gathered groups supply a focus-side bridge between totality and the context's crowd.
Enumeration breaks an apparent mass into individually registered members.
A dense multitude layered one over another supplies the intimidating aggregate that counting de-aggregates.

changed_reading.before: The crowd appears as one piled, overwhelming body around the worshipper.
changed_reading.after: Under the focus's count, even a layered multitude loses anonymity: the apparent mass is contained while each constituent remains individually registered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it applies the focus's enclosure and count to abundant water and immediately following trial, treating provision as a metered test-medium. It remains anchored in the focus accounting vocabulary and the adjacent water/test sequence. Downstream prose should qualify it as an ecological-material analogy, not reduce 'every thing' to water or claim that abundance is numerically rationed in the wording.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًا as exhaustive accounting under the nurturing Lord.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion connect lordship to provision that forms rather than merely rewards.
Exhaustive counting supplies the metering image applied to the provision-test sequence.
A share of irrigation and its channel supply controlled distribution within apparent abundance.
Abundant water and provision supply the material flow brought under the exploratory accounting model.
Assaying a material or person turns the abundant flow into a medium that reveals response.

changed_reading.before: The final enumeration concerns knowledge of entities and completed messages in the abstract.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also makes abundant provision legible as a controlled test-medium: the flow is generous, but its channel, recipients, and effects remain within exhaustive accounting.

strongest_changes: Delivery became receiver-sensitive: hearing, understanding, and assent can expose that a message reached its endpoint.
Messenger agency became exact but bounded: conveyance is completed without ownership of guidance, harm, or final outcomes.
Enclosure and count became operational as no-exit accountability and as a guarded chain of custody.
The closing علم/عدد pair can answer both comparative manpower and uncertainty over the promised term.
summary.what_was_special: The context converted a focus-only statement of completed communication and exhaustive knowledge into several coexisting mechanisms: recipient uptake, bounded commission, protected routing, selective access, inescapable jurisdiction, and force-and-time accounting. The packet's non-dominant ر ب ب to ر ب و mapping also preserved a contained nurture-and-assay reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammatical subject and precise force of لِّيَعْلَمَ remain open; the models do not require one disambiguation.
بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ may denote entrusted informational payload, the messengers' full circumstances, or both.
The surveillance around the messenger may primarily protect transmission rather than audit performance.
The temporal reading of final عَدَدًا is context-activated but less direct than exhaustive enumeration.
